products.name: 2-inch leveling casters, 58 × 58 mm plate, 4 pack
products.headline: 58 × 58 mm hole centers
products.fit: 2 in wheel · 3.22 in installed · 275 lb each
products.summary: Four VEVOR GD-60FD leveling casters for a workbench, cabinet, machine base, or heavy furniture frame with a 73 × 73 mm mounting area and 58 × 58 mm bolt-hole centers. Each 2-inch caster is rated for 275 pounds, installs 3.22 inches high, swivels for movement, and lowers onto a vibration-damping leveling foot for stationary support.

specs.name: Leveling mechanism
specs.value: Hand-adjusted retractable foot with vibration-damping pad

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: Stem sockets, office-chair bases, or mounting surfaces smaller than the stated plate

faqs.q: Will these casters match my existing bolt holes?
faqs.a: Only if the mounting surface accepts a 73 × 73 mm plate with hole centers measuring 58 × 58 mm. Measure center to center before ordering.

faqs.q: Is the 1,100-pound rating for each wheel?
faqs.a: No. Each caster is rated for 275 pounds; 1,100 pounds is the maximum evenly distributed rating for all four.

faqs.q: How tall are the casters after installation?
faqs.a: The stated installation height is 3.22 inches.

faqs.q: How do the leveling feet work?
faqs.a: Move the furniture on the swivel wheels, then use the handles to lower the feet and level the frame over a range of about 0.39 inch.

faqs.q: Are these stem-mounted casters?
faqs.a: No. They require a flat mounting surface and four fasteners through each square plate.

products.name: 4-inch locking plate casters, 74 × 45 mm holes, 4 pack
products.headline: 74 × 45 mm bolt pattern
products.fit: 4 in wheel · 5.11 in installed · 350 lb each
products.summary: Four VEVOR CC-PBJL-4 locking swivel plate casters for furniture, carts, cabinets, and workbenches whose mounting surface accepts a 94 × 64 mm plate with 74 × 45 mm hole centers. Each PVC wheel is 4 inches in diameter, installs 5.11 inches high, and carries up to 350 pounds when correctly fastened.

specs.name: Included fasteners
specs.value: 16 M8 screws, nuts, flat washers and spring washers

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: Stem sockets or furniture legs too narrow for the 94 × 64 mm plate

faqs.q: What bolt pattern do these 4-inch casters use?
faqs.a: The four slotted mounting holes have 74 × 45 mm center spacing on a 94 × 64 mm plate.

faqs.q: How much weight does each caster support?
faqs.a: Up to 350 pounds per caster when mounted correctly. The four-caster set rating is 1,400 pounds with an evenly distributed load.

faqs.q: How much height will the casters add?
faqs.a: The stated installation height is 5.11 inches.

faqs.q: Do all four wheels swivel and lock?
faqs.a: Yes. All four swivel through 360 degrees and include A/B brakes.

faqs.q: Are mounting bolts included?
faqs.a: Yes. The package includes M8 screws, nuts, flat washers, spring washers, two wrenches, and four casters.

products.name: 0.9-inch low-profile fixed repair casters, 4 pack
products.headline: 1 in installed height
products.fit: 0.9 in fixed wheel · 30 lb each · 4 pack
products.summary: Four YORMTOIR LZ000 low-profile fixed casters for supporting a sagging wooden door or lightweight cabinet, drawer unit, coffee table, or under-bed bin without adding the height of a conventional caster. Each rigid nylon wheel is 0.9 inch in diameter, installs about 1 inch high, and supports up to 30 pounds.

specs.name: Caster motion
specs.value: Rigid fixed direction; does not swivel

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: Carpet, uneven floors, outdoor use, water exposure, or loads over 120 lb per set

faqs.q: How much height does each repair caster add?
faqs.a: The stated installation height is approximately 1 inch.

faqs.q: Will these wheels swivel?
faqs.a: No. They are rigid, one-direction fixed casters intended to support movement along a straight path.

faqs.q: Can these support a sagging bedroom door?
faqs.a: Yes, when the door construction accepts the bracket and the load at the wheel does not exceed 30 pounds. Confirm floor clearance through the full swing.

faqs.q: Can I install the casters on the side of furniture?
faqs.a: Yes. The supplied bracket can be mounted on a side, vertically, or on the bottom when the structure provides solid screw support.

faqs.q: Do these work on carpet?
faqs.a: No. They are specified for smooth, even indoor flooring rather than carpet or uneven surfaces.

products.name: 3-inch short-neck recliner tension springs, 2 pack
products.headline: 2.82 in inside-hook length
products.fit: 3 in overall · 2 mm wire · short-neck hooks
products.summary: Two Souldershop 031a galvanized recliner mechanism tension springs measuring 3 inches overall and 2.82 inches from the inside of one hook to the inside of the other. Match the 11/16-inch coil diameter, 18-turn body, 2 mm wire, short-neck hooks, and 45-degree hook deflection to the removed spring before ordering.

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: Long-neck hooks or mechanisms with different length, coil diameter, turns, wire diameter, or hook angle

faqs.q: Is the 3-inch measurement taken between the hooks?
faqs.a: No. Three inches is the overall length. The inside-hook-to-inside-hook measurement is 2.82 inches.

faqs.q: Will these springs fit any recliner brand?
faqs.a: No. Furniture brand does not establish fit. Match the removed spring's full geometry, including hook style, wire diameter, coil diameter, turns, and both length measurements.

faqs.q: Are these long-neck or short-neck springs?
faqs.a: They are short-neck springs with approximately 45-degree hook deflection.

faqs.q: How many springs are included?
faqs.a: Two matching Souldershop 031a springs.

faqs.q: Are installation instructions included?
faqs.a: No. Installation instructions are not included, and a tensioned furniture mechanism should be serviced cautiously.

products.name: 150 N lift-top table hinge pair, 9.52-inch rise
products.headline: 150 N · 9.52 in lift
products.fit: left + right pair · 125° · 100 lb conservative load
products.summary: One left-and-right pair of KEILEOHO gas-supported lift-top table hinges for a coffee table, storage top, desk, or cabinet project. The mechanism provides a 9.52-inch rise, uses 150 N supports, and opens to approximately 125 degrees. Treat 100 pounds as the conservative supported-load claim and verify the folded envelope, mounting structure, and screw depth before installation.

specs.name: Pack quantity
specs.value: 2 mechanisms: one left and one right

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: Single-side installation, unsupported particleboard edges, or applications requiring an unconditional 220 lb rating

faqs.q: Does the package contain one hinge or a pair?
faqs.a: It contains one left mechanism and one right mechanism, plus 20 M5 mounting screws.

faqs.q: How high does the tabletop rise?
faqs.a: The stated lift height is 9.52 inches, or 242 millimeters.

faqs.q: What force are the gas supports?
faqs.a: The supplied mechanism is specified at 150 N.

faqs.q: Can the pair safely support 220 pounds?
faqs.a: Do not publish or design around 220 pounds as an unconditional rating. The source contains conflicting load language, so this draft uses 100 pounds as the conservative supported-load claim.

faqs.q: What should I measure before installation?
faqs.a: Check the 9.5 × 7 inch mechanism envelope, 9.52-inch travel path, closed clearance, panel thickness, framing strength, and safe screw penetration.

faqs.q: Can I install only one side?
faqs.a: No. This product is prepared as a matched left-and-right pair for balanced support.
